On June 21, I placed an order worth 671 Egyptian pounds. Instead of my actual order, I received cat food, which I never ordered. The courier did not wait for me and just left the package at my door. Two minutes later, I picked it up and found cat food inside instead of my items. I immediately called the driver, but he told me it wasn't his problem and that I should contact support. I wrote to support, but there was no response and absolutely no reaction.
After some time, I had to place another order for the items I desperately needed. That second order was delivered correctly. However, sometime later, they brought the exact same items again, claiming it was my "first order," even though that order was already marked as closed. I refused to accept this duplicate order. The courier asked support to call me, and the support agent stated they could only refund the money as Talabat Credit within the app.
However, I am flying out of the country in 4 hours, and I will never need your app or your delivery service ever again. I have lived and worked here for a year, and during this year, this exact situation has happened more than once. Therefore, I demand that the money for this order be refunded as REAL money back to my bank card attached to the Talabat app. I do not care how you process it! I should not have to pay for YOUR mistakes!
I expect my refund immediately!
